headline: SFG @ MIA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 4.68 at MIA 4.16, with a projected total of 8.84. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: SFG moved +0.53 runs while MIA moved -0.59, changing the projected margin by +1.12 runs. NRFI probability rose +8.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Logan Webb has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Liam Hicks, Bryce Eldridge, Casey Schmitt, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Willy Adames because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
